name: list_projects
description: List every project on the account the API key belongs to, with id, name and createdAt. Every other tool takes a projectId from this list.

name: get_insights
description: Get up to 50 insights for a project sorted by score, each with category, severity, title, body, path, evidence, status and source.

arguments.name: status
arguments.desc: Insight status filter: new, ack, done, dismissed or all (default new)

name: get_metrics
description: Get pageviews, sessions, errors, rage and dead click counts, top 20 pages, web vitals p75 and a daily series for a project.

arguments.name: days
arguments.desc: Number of days to cover, 1 to 90 (default 7)

name: get_errors
description: Get grouped JS errors for a project with occurrence count, affected sessions, last seen, a sample path and a sample stack.

arguments.name: days
arguments.desc: Number of days to cover, 1 to 90 (default 30)

name: get_signals
description: Get the current normalized measurements from every connected source (site audit, PageSpeed, GitHub, Sentry, Stripe, analytics), each with a domain, value, unit, target and source.

arguments.name: domain
arguments.desc: Only return signals in this domain, for example security or performance

arguments.name: source
arguments.desc: Only return signals from this source
